title: The delivered values name Ship/Show/Ask, integration and the change; pending change notes state what the release ships
situation: The neutral-conventions story makes the delivered agents generic over a project's conventions: the github-flow procedure, the merge action, the pull-request deliverable and the review request's pull request assumed GitHub flow with a pull request per task, and the pending change notes still stated GitHub flow and a pull request per handover.
decision: (1) The github-flow procedure is deleted; the lead's procedure gains ship-show-ask, noted with who picks (the story, or the lead by risk for a task with no story) and the operator's gate on a change it has asked to review before it joins; the builder names no procedure. (2) The merge action becomes integrate: joining a change to the project's shared work by the project's own convention once every check passes and any review due before it joins approves it. (3) The builder's deliverable pull-request becomes change, its fields unchanged (change, tests, verified); the review request's pullRequest field becomes change. (4) The story form's review field is free text naming Ship, Show or Ask and, where the operator has called it, its gate on a change before it joins; its path no longer says one reviewer per task. (5) Decision-rights glosses: verdict is whether a change's review approves it; sign-off lists a change the operator has asked to review before it joins. (6) Pending change notes state what the next release ships, so those stating a superseded convention or handover are corrected in place, and the story adds one note of its own. (7) The words merged and merged work stay, as the design's word for a story's end.
consequences: The rendered architect, lead, builder and reviewer text and the assignment forms follow; the ledger's own verb descriptions still speak of a task's pull request, left to the ledger story.
